flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (compose/message-sent routes commented out), LinkData.tsx (menu commented out), EditTemplateForm.tsx (onTestMap commented out). ocmsadminapi ManualReviewController (furnish send-email/send-sms, not ad-hoc). ocmsadminprivateapi utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, emailutility/EmailService (generic utilities with no ad-hoc caller). No ad-hoc code in ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi
note: The story asks the officer to choose a test-send of the first message to a mobile number/email address they input, then OCMS sends it and the officer reviews it. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark empty. Main has no ad-hoc preview/compose screen: the Epic37 import and the compose-email, compose-sms and message-sent routes are commented out (App.tsx:56, :257-269), the Compose/Message Sent menu entries are commented out (LinkData.tsx:143-155), and the pages/epic37 folder does not exist. Leftover trace: onTestMap and SendDataMap('TEST', ...) in EditTemplateForm.tsx:43,58 are commented out and refer to an Epic37Map that does not exist. Generic sender utilities exist (SmsUtil.sendSms, EmailService.sendEmail in ocmsadminprivateapi) but no controller or UI calls them with an officer-supplied number/email. The only send-email/send-sms endpoints in the staff API belong to the furnish reply and require txnNo + noticeNo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The test-send option, sending to the entered number/email and reviewing the result do not exist in main

steps.step: Officer chooses test send of the first message and enters a number or email
steps.detail: No preview/compose screen and no test number/email input. The compose-email, compose-sms and message-sent routes are commented out (App.tsx:257-269), onTestMap/SendDataMap('TEST', ...) are commented out (EditTemplateForm.tsx:43,58) and refer to a nonexistent Epic37Map. grep adhoc/ad-hoc, test send, message-sent, compose-sms/compose-email, enotification-send in src of ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi: only commented-out routes/menus (App.tsx:257-269, LinkData.tsx:143-155), path constants (utils/Meta/AdhocNotification.ts), HstAdHocReportService (HST report, not messages) and the 'adhoc' in DataHiveUenFinJob (NRO address, not SMS/email).

steps.step: The system sends the first message to the entered number or email
steps.detail: No send path to an officer-entered recipient. SmsUtil.sendSms (SmsUtil.java:308-317) and EmailService.sendEmail (EmailService.java:64) are only generic utilities in the cron tier with no ad-hoc controller. send-email (ManualReviewController.java:301) and send-sms (:402) in the staff API belong to the furnish reply with txnNo + noticeNo. Real delivery also depends on per-environment properties that cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Officer reviews the test SMS or email received
steps.detail: Receipt on the officer's phone/inbox cannot be verified from the repo, and since the test-send step does not exist there is no test result to review. There is no test-result confirmation screen in main.
